headline: Congress named a Cocoa Beach, Florida post office after Richard K. Salick, an honorary designation with no change to postal service.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 500 North Brevard Avenue in Cocoa Beach, Florida, as the "Richard K. Salick Post Office." It is a naming measure only. The summary does not describe any change to mail service, staffing, or fees.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014, and the summary does not give a separate effective date.
